text:
Sara: Heads-up — I'm OOO Thu-Fri. Need someone to own the release/* branch cut tomorrow morning (UTC). I can do the checklist tonight but can't be on calls. Who can take lead on creating release/1.13 and triaging backports?

Mike: I can create the branch at 09:00 PT if no objections. What's the exact naming and the tag we want? :clock9:

Lee: Naming: release/1.13.0. We'll tag with v1.13.0-rc1 after cut. Policy reminder: only cherry-picks with approved backport labels and passing CI go into the branch.

Sara: Thanks — adding that to the checklist. Also we have 3 pending cherry-picks: #4321 (kv-cache fix), #4350 (batching latency regression), #4367 (docs/version bump). Prioritize 4321 and 4350; docs can wait.

Alex: I can own 4321. I'll open the backport PR and add the backport-ready label. ETA 02:30 UTC.

Nina: I'll take 4350, but need a quick review from @Mike on a test flake. Will ping in PR.

dev-bot: Deploy checklist: branch created -> CI green -> tag rc -> smoke tests. Link: https://ci.example/reports/branch-cut

Mike: Branch created: `git checkout -b release/1.13.0 origin/main` then push. Done at 09:03 PT.

Lee: Dropping a small helper: run `./scripts/backport.sh --pr 4321 --target release/1.13.0` to create cherry-pick branches.

Nina: Backport PRs: BCK-4321, BCK-4350 opened. Labels: backport-ready. Tests running.

Sara: Perfect. If any flakiness blocks landing, prefer deferring to next patch. No risky infra changes during cut window. :no_entry_sign:

Mike: Noted. I'll monitor CI for the next 2 hours and merge once green. Ping me on-call if anything blocks.

Alex: Merged 4321 at 09:40 PT. CI passed. :tada:

Nina: 4350 failed with a timing flake, opened follow-up fix PR and will re-run. Will update thread.

Sara: Thanks team — I'll update the release notes draft and send changelog nudge to marketing once rc tag is up.

Lee: rc tag candidate pushed: `git tag -a v1.13.0-rc1 -m "RC1"` then `git push origin v1.13.0-rc1`. Smoke tests queued.

dev-bot: Smoke tests passed. RC tag v1.13.0-rc1 created by Lee. :white_check_mark:

Mike: All good from release owner side. Closing loop — thanks everyone. If anything else, re-open the thread.
